neighbours.label: being struck by a vehicle: the passive slot (was / been / be) before 'hit', 'struck', 'run over' by a car, bus or train; its output promotes ' hit', ' struck'
fire: Last week a jogger was hit by a delivery van near the school.
Several moose have been struck by trains on that stretch of track.
The elderly man was knocked down by a taxi while crossing the road.
Every year many hedgehogs are killed by cars on country lanes.
She feared her son might be run over by a truck on his bike.
Two pedestrians were injured by a bus that mounted the curb.
The cat had been hit by a motorbike and was limping badly.
Statistically, cyclists are more likely to be struck by a car at junctions.
quiet: Last week a jogger waved at a delivery van near the school.
Several moose wandered along that stretch of track at dawn.
The elderly man hailed a taxi after crossing the road.
Every year many hedgehogs hibernate under hedges on country lanes.
She bought her son a new helmet for riding his bike.
Two pedestrians waited for a bus beside the curb.
The cat chased a motorbike down the lane and came home happy.
Statistically, cyclists ride more slowly at busy junctions.
